record_limit: This file records the provider identities, verdicts, and findings observed in the Foreman terminal session. It is not a raw provider transcript and is not an independent audit.

blocking_findings: Define authorization at execution state, snapshot freshness, resolver identity and code hash, assumption witnesses, replay domain, and signing-state versus execution-state quantification.
Index settlement levels and name the conserved ledger; an internal-ledger fill does not establish destination settlement.
Separate SignAfterResolve from SignBeforeResolve and limit pre-sign verification claims accordingly.
Specify cancel-versus-fill races, residual authorization, stable delivery deduplication, and rollback versus compensation.
Separate the confidential execution trusted base and classify evidence as proof, receipt, or attestation.
Require a five-row status matrix for CAKE, NEAR, current ERC-7683, prior ERC-7683, and OIF.
Bind every adjacent lifecycle artifact through predecessor digests and test substitution, omission, equivocation, and stale snapshots.
Specify the exact authorization predicate, execution-state revalidation, and solver-adjustable fields.
Provide a normative lifecycle automaton with finality, reorganization, cancellation, residual, refund, rollback, and compensation semantics.
Make safety verifiers return typed binding certificates or structured rejections, and require them before signing or submission.
Give confidential execution a separate threat and leakage theorem or exclude it from the release theorem.
Bind state commitment, execution authorization, code hash, and nonce domain.
Distinguish carrier, deposit or escrow, bridge or payout, residual, and settlement evidence.
Specify cancel-or-fill exclusivity and a signed refund destination.
Keep NEAR, current ERC draft, prior ERC draft, OIF, and CAKE evidence tiers separate.
Gate every partial-fill meaning with an explicit residual algebra.

Add deterministic signed-byte decoding, pre-sign effect diff, approval-scope verification, contract code and administration checks, independent observation policy, and settlement receipts to the SDK study.
Give confidential execution a separate trust profile and theorem.
Specify an exact deduplication key, idempotent claim and refund, typed reversals, and reconciliation authority.
